variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the single parent admin account. Choose the name you will use to sign in to the admin portal.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the parent admin account. Set a strong password before using the app beyond local testing.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to sign HTTP-only session cookies. Generate a long random value and keep it private.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: HTTP port for the app to listen on. If omitted, iparent uses 8097.
